courses.overview: 從「哥達基線隧道」延伸到兩項可直接開啟的逐步課程；下列比較分別說明相似原理、差異與驗證練習，並附代表地點、地址或地理描述與近似座標。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Gotthard Base Tunnel into two directly accessible guided courses. Each comparison identifies shared principles, differences and verification exercises, with a representative location, address or geographical descriptor and approximate coordinates.

related.title: 英法海底隧道
related.why: 把「哥達基線隧道」與「英法海底隧道」對照，先辨認能沿用的原理，再檢查不能直接移植的設計條件。
related.whyEn: Compare Gotthard Base Tunnel with Channel Tunnel: identify transferable principles, then check design conditions that cannot be transferred directly.

related.transfer: 長距離雙孔鐵路隧道都要把開挖、襯砌、軌道與逃生通道整合成營運系統。
related.transferEn: Long twin-bore rail tunnels integrate excavation, lining, track and evacuation connections into an operating system.
related.difference: 英法海底隧道跨越海峽；哥達基線隧道穿越深埋山體，地層、地下水、溫度與施工入口條件不同。
related.differenceEn: The Channel Tunnel crosses beneath a strait; Gotthard runs beneath a mountain massif, with different geology, groundwater, temperature and access conditions.
practice: 畫出主隧道與聯絡通道
比較水壓和高覆土的工程影響
為撤離路徑寫出可驗證的要求

related.whyEn: Compare Gotthard Base Tunnel with Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering: identify transferable principles, then check design conditions that cannot be transferred directly.

related.transfer: 山岳隧道需要探勘、開挖回饋、支撐及排水的反覆判斷，地質模型必須隨證據修正。
related.transferEn: Mountain tunnels use iterative investigation, excavation feedback, support and drainage decisions, updating geological models with evidence.
related.difference: 哥達是深埋鐵路基線隧道；雪山是公路隧道，不能把開挖機型、支護間距或營運通風直接移植。
related.differenceEn: Gotthard is a deeply buried rail base tunnel and Hsuehshan a road tunnel; excavation equipment, support spacing and ventilation are not transferable settings.
practice: 標示探勘與實際開挖的回饋
比較公路與鐵路的空間需求
寫出遇到新地質證據時的審查點
practiceEn: Compare road and rail spatial requirements
Define a review point for new geological evidence

courses.summary: 從厄斯特費爾德到博迪奧的基線工程需要在不同岩體中更新地質模型，並把雙管土建、襯砌、防水及鐵路設備接合。課程使用地質與工程師一次文獻作背景，練習把未知條件及介面證據留下來。
courses.summaryEn: The base connection from Erstfeld to Bodio required geological updates across varying ground and integration of twin-tube civil works, lining, water control and railway equipment. Primary geological and engineering sources support exercises in preserving uncertainty and interface evidence.
courses.connection: 可與英法海峽隧道、雪山隧道共同學習地質更新、量測及移交；鐵路、公路、山岳與海底的條件不同，通風、斷面及營運假設須各自查證。
courses.connectionEn: Compare geological updating, measurement and handover with the Channel and Hsuehshan tunnels. Rail, road, mountain and undersea settings differ, so ventilation, cross-section and operating assumptions need separate evidence.
